B. Tech. Admission Process at LIT University 
 
CIRCULAR:- 
All 
students/candidates 
seeking 
admission 
to 
Laxminarayan 
Innovation 
Technological University (LIT University) are hereby informed to visit the 
Admission Centre for completing their admission formalities and for any assistance or 
guidance related to the admission process  
Admission Centre: 
Computer Centre and Ground Floor Classroom, Main Building of the University. 
 
Admission Centre Timings:  
10:30 AM to 5:00 PM including holidays as per CAP schedule 
Address: LIT University, Opposite Bharat Nagar, Amravati Road, Nagpur 440033 
Candidates are advised to complete the admission process within the above-mentioned 
working hours and carry all necessary documents as mentioned on next page with them 
and fees to be paid online as per fees given structure. 
For further information or assistance, please contact the Admission Centre. 
Dr. Manoj Meshram: - 9420856631 
Prof. Chandan Chawhan: - 8087303834 
Dr. Pallavi Giri: - 9623060060 
 
Boys’ Hostel 
For Boys Hostel Admission students shall submit separate application at Hostel Office 
after admission confirmation. Hostel fees is Rs. 15000/- per year and Mess fees is Rs. 
2800/- per month (subject to revision) 
Contact for Hostel Admission  
Warden - Dr. Ramesh Birmod: - 7020669020 
Clerk - Mr. Sagar Mokaddam: - 8983492567 
 
Girls’ Hostel 
LIT University don’t have girls’ hostel however girls can enquire with Warden, Girls 
Hostel RTM Nagpur University, Opposite Indira Gandhi Hospital, Near LAD Square, 
Gandhi Nagar, Nagpur for availability, if any. 
Private hostel contacts will be shared at admission centre 
 
ACAP Admission Round 
Students seeking admission for ACAP institute level seats shall register and apply 
on CET website till 7th Sept 2026. Fees for ACAP round will be collected on the 
day of round. The date of conduct of round shall be notified on LITU website 
(litu.edu.in) later. 

 
DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR ADMISSION 
 
 MH-CET Score Card 
 Document Verification Receipt-cum-Acknowledgement  
 Seat Acceptance Letter (Freeze Letter) 
 Allotment Letter 
 Caste Certificate 
 Cast Validity Certificate 
 Non Creamy Layer Certificate 
 10th Standard Mark sheet 
 12th / Diploma Standard Mark sheet  
 12th / Diploma Leaving/ Transfer Certificate 
 Gap Certificate, if required 
 Age, Nationality & Domicile Certificate 
 EWS Certificate 
 Income Certificate 
 PWD (Handicap-Disability) Certificate 
 Migration Certificate (For CBSE/ Other State) 
 APAAR ID
